name: lunaris
description: LUNARIS — Lunar Mission Intelligence & Surface Operations Platform (monorepo root)

scripts.dev:api: uv run uvicorn lunaris_api.main:app --reload --reload-dir apps/api/src --reload-dir packages/science/src --reload-dir packages/data/src --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @lunaris/web && npm run format:check && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && uv run mypy
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:py
scripts.contracts:generate: uv run lunaris-api-openapi && npm run generate -w @lunaris/shared-types
scripts.contracts:check: uv run lunaris-api-openapi --check && npm run check:generated -w @lunaris/shared-types
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run contracts:check && npm test
